///THIS REPORT WAS RECEIVED VIA THE WEB REPORTING TOOL.///ON 09/15/13 AT 1925 HOURS, TERMINAL TRAINMASTER, REPORTED A SUSPECT ODOR NEAR A BLOCK OF 16 CARS THAT REPORTEDLY CONTAINED A HIGHLY FLAMMABLE COMMODITY (POSSIBLY BUTANE), BUT HAD BEEN UNABLE TO LOCATE A LEAK OR SPILL AT MP ANB 865.00 ON AN UNKNOWN SUBDIVISION. THIS WAS LOCATED ACROSS FROM THE HUMP TOWER ON DEPARTURE TRACK B9 IN THE TILFORD YARD, 1942 MARIETTA BOULEVARD, IN ATLANTA, GEORGIA. CRISIS COMMUNICATIONS MANAGER, WAS NOTIFIED. UPDATE: AT 1955 HOURS, CRISIS COMMUNICATIONS MANAGER, REQUESTED THE PSCC DELAY CONTACTING LOCAL OFFICIALS UNTIL ADDITIONAL INFORMATION COULD BE GAINED, AND CSX CONTRACTOR, HULL'S ENVIRONMENTAL, HAD BEEN NOTIFIED TO RESPOND AND INSPECT THE CARS. UPDATE: AT 2159 HOURS, CRISIS COMMUNICATIONS MANAGER, ADVISED THE DOME ON ONE OF THE CARS IS FROSTED OVER SO THERE IS A PRODUCT RELEASE BUT THERE IS NO PRODUCT ON THE GROUND. ATLANTA POLICE WERE NOTIFIED. UPDATE: AT 2227 HOURS, CRISIS COMMUNICATIONS MANAGER, ADVISED THE CAR NUMBER IS SHPX 221121. HULLS, ENVIRONMENTAL SERVICES, ARE ON SCENE.

properties.summary: Incident Type: FIXED - NRC Report ID: 1011621 - Medium Affected: WATER - Suspected Responsible Party: QG, LLC
properties.content:
Report Details
NRC Report ID: 1011621
Incident Time: 2012-05-14 11:30:00
Nearest City: Dickson, TN
Location: PLATING OPERATIONS ARE LOCATED IN THE MIDDLE OF THE FACILITY. 1665 OLD COLUMBIA HIGHWAY
Incident Type: FIXED
Material: HEXAVALENT CHROME
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: QG, LLC
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 36.075035, -87.385686 (Approximated from ZIP)
Report Description
FACILITY PERSONNEL DISCOVERED A BREACH IN A TRENCH LINE AND ASSOCIATED SUMP THAT IS UTILIZED TO CONVEY RINSE WATER FROM COPPER PLATING TANKS. THE RINSE WATER CONTAINS MISCELLANEOUS SOLVENT AND COPPER SULFATE. IN ADDITION, THE ASSOCIATED SUMP ALSO COLLECTS RINSE WATER FROM CHROME SCRUBBER EQUIPMENT. THIS RINSE WATER MAY CONTAIN TRACE AMOUNTS OF HEXAVALENT CHROME. THE RINSE WATERS ARE TRANSFERRED FROM THE ASSOCIATED SUMP TO AN ONSITE WATER PRETREATMENT SYSTEM BEFORE FINAL DISCHARGE TO THE LOCAL PUBLICLY OWNED TREATMENT WORKS. THE TRENCH LINE AND ASSOCIATED SUMP HAVE BEEN TAKEN OUT OF SERVICE AS OF 12 PM ON 15-MAY-2012. THE RINSE WATERS ARE BEING DIVERTED TO CONTAINERS/TOTES AND ARE BEING MANUALLY TRANSFERRED TO THE ONSITE WATER PRETREATMENT SYSTEM. LITTLEJOHN ENGINEERING ASSOCIATES, A THIRD PARTY ENVIRONMENTAL CONSULTANT, WAS ONSITE ON 15-MAY-2012 TO ASSESS THE SITUATION AND WILL DEVELOP A WORK PLAN BASED ON THOSE OBSERVATIONS FOR POTENTIAL REMEDIATION.

THE CALLER STATED THAT ON THE SIDE OF THE BUILDING NEAR THE OFFICE, ACID WAS SPILLED AND LEFT ON THE GROUND. ON THE LEFT SIDE OF THE BUILDING, GREASE WAS WASHED INTO A STORM DRAIN DURING CLEANING OPERATIONS. FINALLY, THE COMPANY USES A TRUCK TO COLLECT GREASE FROM RESTAURANTS AND THEY CLEAN THE TRUCK OVER A STORM DRAIN.
